what_worked: Genuine competitive-map synthesis (slide 8) and four concrete entry strategies grounded in observed whitespace gaps.
fix_next: Add more charts from the frozen dataset (e.g., median comparisons, domain-rating distributions) to replace text-heavy assertion slides.
verdict: Focused niche thesis with strong narrative arc, but thin on verifiable data visualization.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: states 262 use RevenueCat; frozen reference is 189. Slide 5: whole-dataset median $400 is not verifiable against reference and likely inaccurate (frozen overall median is harder to pin but category medians suggest a different figure).

evidence.insight: Slides 7-10 go beyond description: Jungle Bee outlier dissected for booking-volume vs. take-rate, competitive map of 6 sub-segments with density labels, four actionable entry strategies with comp pricing. Domain-rating comparison (24.2 vs 16.7) adds a novel angle.
evidence.narrative: Clean arc: method → market context → category positioning → outlier → competitive map → synthesis → recommendations → caveats. Slide 9 synthesis ties five threads. Slide 12 closes with a punchy reframe. Each slide advances the 'small but untried' thesis.
evidence.framing: Slide 1 states compset/opportunity-mapping purpose; slide 2 explains dual-source method and 8-of-1000 sampling caveat; slide 11 lists four honest limitations including survivorship bias and snapshot nature. Target reader (indie builder vs investor) could be sharper.
evidence.accuracy: Slide 4 category totals match reference (AI $2.36M, Marketing $1.32M, E-comm $1.11M, SaaS $704K, Education $524K, Analytics $368K). But RevenueCat 262 vs 189 is a clear error. Whole-dataset median $400 unverified. Live-site Travel figures ($378 median, 133 listings) are external and unauditable against frozen data.
evidence.visual: Consistent dark theme, clear typography hierarchy, section labels. Only one data chart (slide 4 bar with square-root scale, well-annotated). Slides 8 and 10 use card layouts effectively. Deck is text-heavy; more frozen-data visualizations would strengthen evidence substantially.

change_reason: Lowered accuracy from 6.5 to 6.0: RevenueCat count error (262 vs 189) is a clear factual mistake on a verifiable frozen-data figure, and the whole-dataset median $400 claim is unsupported. Other scores confirmed as appropriate.
